Conjunction.Description: Merges energies; very powerful; can be harmonious or conflicting depending on planets involved.

Opposition.Description: Polarization; reflection and projection; potential for balance or conflict.

Trine.Description: Harmonious and easy energy exchange; talents and natural flows.

Square.Description: Dynamic tension; challenges that drive growth and confrontation.

Sextile.Description: Easy flow of energy; opportunities that require initiative.

Quincunx.Description: Adjustment aspect; incongruent energies that must compromise or shift.

Semi-sextile.Description: Mildly positive; represents potential growth through minor adjustments.

Semi-square.Description: Minor tension; encourages action through subtle challenge. (Also called Octile.)

Sesquiquadrate.Description: Minor challenging aspect; irritations that require discipline.

Quintile.Description: Creative/talent-driven link; refined skill or artistry.

Biquintile.Description: Harmonic creative flow; specialized talents or genius-level expression.

Decile.Description: Semi-quintile; subtle creativity, finesse and technique.

Tridecile.Description: Quintile family; inventive, elegant problem solving.

Quindecile.Description: Intense focus/compulsion; persistent drive toward integration.

Biseptile.Description: Septile family; unusual timing/synchrony, creative compulsion.

Triseptile.Description: Septile family; inner calling, synchronistic pressure to adjust.
